## Description of Changes
Briefly describe the purpose and design decisions behind this change.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds capability)
- [ ] New declarative profile or evaluator
- [ ] Performance optimization / ISO size reduction

## Checklist
- [ ] My code adheres to the project's coding and formatting standards.
- [ ] I have verified that `pytest tests/test_evoforge.py -v` passes locally.
- [ ] I have confirmed that bit-for-bit reproducibility and cryptographic manifest integrity are preserved.
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation if introducing new boot parameters or profiles.
